thread:
maria: Heads-up  Need final landing copy that ties to launch posts, webinar narrative, and inbound routing. Copy freeze EOD Monday. Who takes hero + CTAs + forms?

alex: I can take hero + CTA variants. Will deliver a tight family of lines + per-mode subcopy by tomorrow morning.

sam: I'll own the webinar benchmark paragraph and two short customer vignettes (one performance-focused, one cost-focused). @alex please export p50 latency + tokens/sec for our common model family.

jordan: Ill map inbound funnels: 1) Hosted trial (light form) 2) Dedicated capacity (sales intake) 3) Private consult (enterprise intake). Recommend hidden fields: `product_mode` + `campaign_source`.

kevin: Hero families to test (pick one for initial pass):
- Performance-first: `Predictable low-latency LLM inference for production`
- Economics-first: `Reduce inference cost while preserving quality`
- Reliability-first: `SLA-backed inference with graceful fallbacks`
We'll A/B test across cohorts post-launch.

maria: For the copy pass I need: final hero, single supporting paragraph, 3 bullets (technical differentiators), CTA destination mapping, and microcopy for the top-of-funnel form (privacy + timing). Keep it developer-forward.

alex: First-pass copy below (edits welcome):
- Hosted hero: `Instant API to ship LLM features`
  Hosted sub: "SDKs, streaming, predictable per-token pricing, and instant onboarding."
  CTA: `Start free trial` -> /signup?utm=launch_hosted
- Dedicated hero: `Reserved GPUs for predictable throughput`
  Dedicated sub: "SLA-backed capacity, configurable autoscaling, and throughput guarantees for production."
  CTA: `Request capacity quote` -> /sales/dedicated?utm=launch_dedicated
- Private hero: `Run inference in your VPC or on-prem`
  Private sub: "KMS/HSM integrations, audit logs, and compliance-ready deployments."
  CTA: `Contact enterprise` -> /enterprise/contact?utm=launch_private

sam: Webinar benchmark blurb: "On representative chat-like workloads, median token latency was ~30ms on modern GPU instances; batching + KV cache yielded ~2.5x aggregate throughput. Customers using cache + quantized variants reported 30-40% inference cost reductions without material quality loss on evals." Two short cases: "Acme.ai: 42% cost reduction after caching + quantization." "HyperShop: reduced 95th tail by 28% with KV cache tuning." Slides incoming.

jordan: Form fields and routing: 
- Hosted: `email`, `company` (optional), `use_case` (dropdown). Auto-provision trial, onboarding email sequence.
- Dedicated: `company`, `expected_rps`, `region`, `phone`. Routes to SDR queue A, triggers calendar for qualification.
- Private: `company`, `security_contact`, `compliance_needs`, `nda_needed`. Routes AE + legal.
Hidden fields: `product_mode`, `campaign_source`, `utm_content`.

kevin: A/B cohorts = `webinar_attendees`, `organic_search`, `paid_social`. Test three hero variants (performance/economics/reliability) for 14 days. Primary metric: trial starts; secondary: MQLs for Dedicated/Private.

maria: Analytics events to instrument: `hero_impression`, `cta_click`, `form_submit`, `trial_provisioned`. Ensure `product_mode` in all events. Microcopy suggestion: "We respect your privacy. We won't share your info. Trial access within 24 hours."

alex: I'll produce an annotated mockup + copy doc with event names and UTM schema by 10:30AM tomorrow.

ops-bot: Event created: "Landing copy review + webinar alignment" Tue 14:00 UTC. Attendees: maria, alex, sam, jordan, kevin. Link: https://cal.example.com/6187660001

maria: Thanks  Bring assets to the 2pm review: sam (slides), jordan (form schema + routing), alex (mockups + copy), kevin (A/B plan). :thumbsup:
